labels_ge12.name: Sturmpioniere
labels_ge12.notes: Crop is a large region of the sheet: besides the tile it also contains a flame/fire template with suppressed token, a Hedgerow Side marker, MG Group and Othman unit counters, a Magnetic Mine option (15, X3), an Assault Group option (75), a Ferocious option and the tops of two further cards (cut off at the bottom). Only the tile is labelled here. Slot 1 clearly wider than the other three (about 370 vs 285 px). Black bar links slots 2 and 3 through the middle panel. Small tab above slot 4 shows '0' (a number, not a star) - treated as special ability tab. Unit pictures: Ob Othman (two stars), Goliath, Fire Group, MG Group; three red X squares.
